hypotheses.title: Upstream payments provider degradation caused the checkout failures
hypotheses.summary: The payments provider returned 504s and our circuit breaker opened minutes before the checkout 502 spike; the provider's own status page confirmed an upstream incident.
unknowns: Whether a specific charge.create call pattern worsened the provider timeouts
validation_steps: Correlate the provider 504 timestamps with our 502 spike
Confirm the provider incident window against their status API

impact_claims.description: Checkout returned 502 errors to 31% of requests across all regions

remediation_items.description: Add a fallback and circuit-aware handling for charge.create outages

hypotheses.title: Missing client-side retry and backoff amplified the provider blip
hypotheses.summary: Our integration has no retry or backoff on charge.create, so a transient provider degradation surfaced directly to users as checkout failures.
unknowns: How many 502s a bounded retry would have absorbed
validation_steps: Replay the provider timeout window against a retry-enabled client in staging

remediation_items.description: Implement idempotent retries with jittered backoff on charge.create

hypotheses.title: A local checkout deploy regressed payments handling
hypotheses.summary: A recent checkout deploy might have changed payments handling, but no deploy occurred in this window.
unknowns: Whether any out-of-band change touched the checkout service
validation_steps: Audit the deploy log for the checkout service around 09:00-09:10
